meta.seoTitle: Karimjee Builders Ltd | Construction & Civil Engineering — Tanzania
meta.seoDescription: Award-winning construction and civil engineering firm delivering government-tendered and private projects across Tanzania since 2008.

hero.headline: Building Tanzania's
hero.subheadline: We deliver government-tendered construction projects on time, on budget, and to the highest standard — across mainland Tanzania and Zanzibar.

about.heading:
Built on Trust,
Delivered with Precision
body: Karimjee Builders Limited is a Dar es Salaam-based construction and civil engineering firm with over 15 years of experience delivering roads, buildings, water infrastructure, and government-tendered projects across Tanzania.

We combine seasoned local expertise with international construction standards to deliver every project on time and within budget. Our compliance record, technical capacity, and financial standing make us a preferred partner for government agencies, NGOs, and private developers.

director.name: Eng. Rashid Karimjee
director.title: Managing Director & Lead Engineer
director.quote: Every structure we build is a commitment to the communities that will use it for generations.

items.title: Civil Construction
items.body: Roads, bridges, drainage systems, and public infrastructure delivered to TANROADS and municipal standards.

items.title: Building Works
items.body: Commercial, residential, and institutional buildings — from foundation to finishing.

items.title: Water & Sanitation
items.body: Boreholes, piped water systems, and sanitation facilities for rural and urban communities.

items.title: Renovation & Retrofitting
items.body: Structural upgrades, MEP works, and full building renovation for existing facilities.

items.title: Project Management
items.body: End-to-end project supervision, BOQ preparation, and contractor coordination.

items.title: Tender Preparation
items.body: Technical and financial tender documentation for government and donor-funded projects.

items.title: Government-Registered
items.body: Fully registered with BRELA, TRA, PPRA, and CRB Class I contractor status.

items.title: On-Time Delivery
items.body: We have a 96% on-schedule delivery rate across all completed contracts.

items.title: Local Expertise
items.body: Deep knowledge of Tanzania's terrain, regulations, and supply chains.

items.title: Qualified Team
items.body: In-house engineers, quantity surveyors, and site managers on every project.

items.title: ISO & Safety Certified
items.body: ISO 9001:2015 certified. Zero-fatality record across 15 years of operations.
